import React from 'react'; import { Container, Typography, Grid, Card, CardContent, Box, Chip, } from '@mui/material'; import { Business as BusinessIcon, Work as WorkIcon, People as PeopleIcon, CheckCircle as CheckCircleIcon, Pending as PendingIcon, } from '@mui/icons-material'; import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext'; const CompanyDashboard = () => { const { currentUser } = useAuth(); // Mock data - replace with actual API calls later const dashboardData = { stats: { jobsPosted: currentUser?.profile?.jobsPosted?.length || 0, totalApplications: currentUser?.profile?.totalApplications || 0, pendingApplications: currentUser?.profile?.pendingApplications || 0, hiredCandidates: currentUser?.profile?.hiredCandidates || 0 } }; const data = dashboardData; return ( {/* Welcome Section */} Welcome back, {currentUser?.profile?.name || 'Company'}! Manage your recruitment and candidate pipeline {/* Statistics Grid */} Jobs Posted {data.stats.jobsPosted} Active positions Total Applications {data.stats.totalApplications} All time Pending Reviews {data.stats.pendingApplications} Awaiting action Hired Candidates {data.stats.hiredCandidates} Successful hires {/* Company Profile */} Company Profile Company Name Industry Approval Status {/* Quick Stats */} Recruitment Overview Active Job Postings Total Applicants Pending Reviews Successful Hires {/* Company Portal Info */} Company Portal Features Use the navigation bar above to access all company features:
  • Post new job opportunities for graduates
  • Review qualified applicants automatically matched by the system
  • Filter candidates based on academic performance and skills
  • Manage your company profile and job postings
  • Track application status and communicate with candidates
 ); }; export default CompanyDashboard;
